establishments.title: Establishments
establishments.intro: The places the company issues documents from. Each numbers its documents on its own; one of them is the default.

numbering.title: Document numbering
numbering.intro: How each establishment numbers each kind of document. Numbers are given when a document is issued; until then a series may resume at any number.
numbering.preview_invalid: This format cannot number a document yet.

fields.format_hint: Text around {YYYY}, {YY}, {MM}, {EST} (the establishment's code) and one sequence, {SEQ} or {SEQ:5} padded to five digits.
fields.nextNumber_hint: A company moving from another tool continues where it stopped.
fields.nextNumber_frozen_hint: Documents already carry numbers from this series: it continues from here, so no number is skipped or used twice.

custom_fields.title: Custom fields
custom_fields.intro: The fields your company adds to its customers and products. A field's key and type are fixed once declared; retire a field rather than delete it, and the values are kept.
custom_fields.no_company: Choose a company to manage its custom fields.

fields.key_hint: Lowercase letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter. It cannot change later.
fields.label: Label
fields.isActive_hint: A retired field is no longer shown; the values are kept.

errors.key_taken: Another field already has this key.
errors.invalid: The field was refused. Check its label, choices and position.

modules.title: Modules
modules.intro: The modules your company uses. A module switched off leaves the menu and its pages no longer open; its data is kept and comes back when you switch it on again.

delivery_notes.invoiced_note: This note is on an issued invoice: it is neither delivered nor cancelled any more, and can still be printed.
